yobain.scope: Read-only independent visual audit. No app/source measurement modifications. All readings visually inspected. Confirmed_current means image-compatible, not guaranteed ground truth. Proposed offsets are approximate apparent image contacts; no 100 percent accuracy claim. No tide, registration or field validation was performed.
limitations: Native z17 pixels do not resolve every water, wet sediment, wrack and shallow seabed boundary.
Visual intervals are not statistical confidence intervals and omit absolute registration/tide errors.
Uncertain pending and accepted readings remain unresolved; rejected source candidates are not recoveries.
No curve or partial cache region was filled by interpolation.
Candidate-image files 01-03 were not persisted due disk exhaustion; their generated images were inspected directly and their script/parameters are retained.
